tools.name: platform_info
tools.description: Return OnlyChili's platform summary, 8 supported languages, public browse hubs, creator economics, compliance policy, and machine-readable discovery URLs.

tools.name: search_videos
tools.description: Search OnlyChili's public AI-generated video and drama series catalog by title, localized series name (across all 8 supported languages), or #tag.

tools.name: list_latest_videos
tools.description: List recent publicly published AI-generated videos on OnlyChili with 8-language titles, canonical watch URLs, creator channels, durations, ratings, and access modes.

tools.name: list_series
tools.description: List public serialized AI drama playlists on OnlyChili with 8-language titles, canonical playlist URLs, episode counts, and creator handles.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Fetch full metadata, 8-language titles/descriptions, and canonical watch URLs for a single publicly visible video by UUID.

tools.name: get_channel
tools.description: Fetch public creator channel profile, bio, follower count, video count, and canonical 8-locale channel URLs by handle.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "platform_info" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Return OnlyChili's platform summary, supported languages, public browse hubs, compliance policy, and machine-readable discovery URLs." → after: "Return OnlyChili's platform summary, 8 supported languages, public browse hubs, creator economics, compliance policy, and machine-readable discovery URLs."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
